end.summary:
- Discussed everyday ways to keep school clean, green and safe.
- Identified paper and wrappers as waste and described separating wet and dry waste.
- Identified leftover food as wet waste and linked composting with soil and plant growth.
- Explained that keeping school clean is everyone’s shared job and that using bins reduces litter.
- Mixed up whether foil wrappers can become compost; this was not corrected in the lesson.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting wet and dry waste, explaining composting, and describing how everyone can help keep school clean and safe. They explained that using bins prevents litter and reduces sweeping work. Anika mixed up foil wrappers with compostable waste, and this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, practise sorting a few household items into wet, dry, and recyclable waste, especially checking food leftovers and foil wrappers.
